title: Orbit real-world data and autonomous engineering benchmark
note: Run the data builder before these tasks. Acceptance criteria describe what to verify; they are not claims that any task has passed.

tasks.prompt: Reconcile the CSV and JSON records against manifest.json. Identify missing observations and indicator units.
acceptance: Report exact retrieval timestamp and row count.
Distinguish null/blank from numeric zero.
Do not fabricate or silently impute values.
Use indicator codes and units from the manifest.

tasks.prompt: Build a responsive data explorer using the generated World Bank dataset, with year filters, latest values, charts and an accessible table.
acceptance: All displayed values come from the dataset.
Charts identify indicator and unit.
Missing values remain distinct from zero.
Filters update charts and table consistently.
Mobile layout and keyboard navigation work.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise source-linked report explaining trends, coverage, units and limitations.
acceptance: Numerical claims trace to source rows.
Include source, retrieval time and codes.
Do not infer causation.
Disclose current-USD GDP and missing observations.

tasks.prompt: Create an analysis workbook with raw data, summary, filters, frozen headers and readable number formats.
acceptance: Preserve raw source values.
Keep missing values blank.
Include units, source and retrieval time.
Summary matches raw data.

tasks.prompt: Fix a dashboard bug where missing values appear as zero and changing the year filter does not update the chart.
acceptance: Missing values remain missing.
All dependent views update with the filter.
Add regression checks.
Avoid unrelated edits.

tasks.prompt: Review the data app for unsafe rendering and accidental exposure of credentials or local files.
acceptance: Treat dataset labels as data, not HTML.
Do not expose secrets or environment variables.
Use safe DOM text rendering.
Document external requests.

tasks.prompt: Build a forecast explorer for the selected city.
acceptance: Label data as forecast, not observed weather.
Display local time and units.
Preserve null measurements.

tasks.prompt: Build an earthquake event map and searchable table.
acceptance: Use actual coordinates.
Show magnitude, depth, event time and source link.
Disclose feed time window.
Display rate date and base/quote currency.
Label reference rates, not trading quotes.
Retain provider attribution and caveats.

tasks.prompt: Build a NASA EONET natural-events dashboard.
acceptance: Show event title, category, geometry date and source.
Treat metadata as curated and revisable.
Do not present as a complete hazard inventory.

tasks.prompt: Combine all successful datasets into one explorer.
acceptance: Keep units and time semantics separate.
Show source-specific retrieval times.
A failed source must not erase successful datasets.

tasks.prompt: Improve a source adapter that fails intermittently.
acceptance: Use bounded timeouts and response-size limits.
Record per-source errors.
Preserve successful sibling datasets.

tasks.prompt: Add a new public data source using the existing adapter contract.
acceptance: Use a fixed HTTPS endpoint.
Record provenance, units, timestamp and caveats.
Add JSON/CSV output and validator coverage.

tasks.prompt: Build a country profile comparison from REST Countries and World Bank data.
acceptance: Keep source and update timing separate.
Show currencies, languages, area and population with field labels.
Do not assume the reference profile and World Bank indicators share the same observation date.
Preserve original source URLs.
